tasks.goal: Enable only the approved system and workflow Mapper surfaces and prove that their resources can be discovered.
input_facts: Infrastructure already packages the Boot 3 MyBatis starter
invariants: Every Mapper read accepts and applies tenant ID
XML uses bound parameters and does not replace service authorization
interface_contracts: ProjectMemberMapper returns the existing member columns and role rows
WorkflowDefinitionMapper returns definition list summaries and a count without definition_json
non_goals: No mapper migration outside the two approved read clusters
No global mapper scan or dependency upgrade
action_bounds: Add the minimal direct module dependency if required
Create only the two authorized Mapper interfaces and XML files
Run a focused compilation/test check before consuming the Mappers from services
acceptance_checks: Mapper XML contains tenant predicates for every select
Target Maven modules compile/test with mapper resources present
tasks.rollback: Revert the new direct dependencies and Mapper files.
stop_conditions: Mapper discovery requires an unapproved global configuration or public-contract change
escalation_conditions: A required dependency or consumer lies outside the approved scope

tasks.goal: Replace the project-member role N+1 read with one tenant-bound batch lookup while preserving response assembly.
input_facts: ProjectService.members currently performs one member query and one role query for each member
ProjectService already performs member:read and project-access checks before its query
invariants: Authorization and project access execute before Mapper calls
Existing order, avatar URL decoration, and role order remain unchanged
Empty member results do not execute an IN () query
interface_contracts: ProjectService.members returns the same List<Map<String,Object>> response shape
non_goals: No attachment or project-access behavior changes
action_bounds: Inject the new Mapper without changing other constructors more than necessary for compatibility
Group role rows in memory by member ID
Add focused interaction and result tests
acceptance_checks: A multi-member test proves one member query and one batch-role query
A zero-member test proves no role batch lookup
tasks.rollback: Revert the ProjectService and its focused test changes; Mapper files may remain unused only during local rollback.
stop_conditions: Response equivalence requires an unapproved consumer or data-contract change
escalation_conditions: Tenant or authorization behavior differs from the established service path

tasks.goal: Persist and read workflow definition summaries without list JSON loading, and synchronize every affected standard and Flowable version write path.
input_facts: WorkflowService.definitions currently reads a latest-version JSON correlated subquery only to calculate requires_configuration
WorkflowService and FlowableWorkflowService both create, edit, publish, and unpublish/copy version data
invariants: Summary fields are additive and tenant-bound
Full definition JSON remains read by definition detail/version paths only
All normal and Flowable writers update summaries in their enclosing transaction
interface_contracts: Workflow definition PageResult and detail response retain existing fields and paging behavior
non_goals: No schema rewrite or old-migration edit
action_bounds: Before creating V201, verify it remains unoccupied
Add only latest_version_no and requires_configuration summary fields plus the minimal support index
Centralize summary derivation in the authorized projector and call it from each affected write path
Add lifecycle and focused MySQL/Flyway parity tests
acceptance_checks: Migration backfill matches supported configuration-placeholder JSON
Standard and Flowable create/edit/publish/unpublish paths invoke summary projection
Workflow focused tests and migration test pass
tasks.rollback: Revert application changes; retain additive schema and issue a later append-only compensation migration for any data correction.
stop_conditions: A writer cannot be covered without modifying an unapproved path
Backfill behavior disagrees with the supported Java projection
escalation_conditions: Migration requires destructive DDL or changes to current_version semantics

tasks.goal: Measure the final member and definition read paths with bounded metrics and expose only the necessary Actuator endpoint.
input_facts: Boot currently exposes health and info only
Micrometer is available through Spring Boot
Metric tag keys are fixed by the approved design
invariants: Only operation, scope_type, and outcome tag keys are used
Existing API error behavior is rethrown after outcome=error is recorded
No management endpoint besides metrics is newly exposed
interface_contracts: ccb.project.members.query and ccb.workflow.definitions.query retain fixed tag cardinality
non_goals: No external telemetry backend, cache, or request-ID tagging
action_bounds: Instrument only the two approved service methods
acceptance_checks: Both timer names are registered after their read paths execute
Metric tags are restricted to the approved fixed values
Actuator metrics endpoint is exposed without broader endpoint exposure
tasks.rollback: Revert the timer calls, constructor wiring, tests, and management configuration.
stop_conditions: Required observability needs an unapproved telemetry service or dynamic tag
escalation_conditions: Security policy requires a different management endpoint exposure approach

tasks.goal: Verify compatibility, tenant-bound behavior, migration backfill, metric visibility, and scope conformance across the integrated change.
input_facts: All product changes and focused tests are present
High-assurance mode requires three samples and heterogeneous sensors
invariants: No changes outside the approved task scope
No claim of passing tests that were not run
interface_contracts: Existing member and definition list API behavior
MySQL schema and Actuator metrics endpoints
non_goals: Production deployment, push, merge, or release
action_bounds: Run focused, module, full Maven, MySQL/Flyway, local API, Actuator, scope, and diff checks only
Record actual execution and observation evidence
acceptance_checks: System, workflow, full Maven, migration, API, and Actuator checks are run or their environmental limitation is recorded
Scope checker and git diff --check pass
All five requirements have final sensor evidence
tasks.rollback: Use the T2-T4 rollback boundaries; retain schema changes as documented.
stop_conditions: Cross-tenant result, summary parity mismatch, or P0/P1 regression
escalation_conditions: Local MySQL/API runtime is unavailable after documented attempts
